info.name: Agentic Engineering Orchestrator
info.description: Demo collection for the local loopback-only orchestrator. Start PostgreSQL and Temporal, then run the Spring app before sending requests. The collection is organized by use case. Requests that depend on a workflow state must be sent only when the status shown in Get Run says the required state. Local profile requires no token. In secure profile, set accessToken in the selected environment. This orchestrator generates and validates proposals; it does not deploy or apply them to another service.

item.name: 00 - Start Here and Monitoring
item.description: Confirm the backend is up, see supported examples, and inspect aggregate reliability counters.

request.description: Use case: confirm Spring Boot and its health contributors are ready. Expected status: 200 and status UP.
Use case: inspect the built-in GREENFIELD, BROWNFIELD, and AMBIGUOUS prompts.
Use case: inspect aggregate run success, retries, recovery, and latency. In secure profile this request needs the orchestrator:ops scope.
Use case: scrape application metrics. In secure profile this requires orchestrator:ops. In local profile it is available without a token.

item.name: 01 - Greenfield: Build a New Service
item.description: Demo a new product/service request. Create the run, approve its plan, inspect task progress, then review/export artifacts when ready.

exec: pm.test('Run waits for plan approval', function () { pm.expect(data.status).to.eql('AWAITING_APPROVAL'); });

request.description: Use case: start a new service proposal. The response stores the run ID in greenfieldRunId. Creating a run does not begin execution until the plan is approved.
Use case: approve the plan and allow workflow execution. Send after Create Greenfield Run. In secure mode this requires orchestrator:approve.

item.name: Get Greenfield Run and Task Status

request.description: Use case: refresh run state. Inspect status, tasks (nodeKey/status/attemptCount/outputSummary), audit, and artifacts. Repeat while work is running. In secure mode this requires orchestrator:read.
Use case: accept the proposal. Send only after Get Greenfield Run reports AWAITING_ARTIFACT_REVIEW. In secure mode this requires orchestrator:approve.
Use case: download accepted proposal files as a ZIP. Send after artifact acceptance. This does not deploy or install the files. In secure mode this requires orchestrator:read.

item.name: 02 - Brownfield: Enhance Existing Code
item.description: Demo an enhancement against a bounded caller-supplied read-only source snapshot. The revision is caller-declared and is not verified against Git.

request.description: Use case: request an enhancement/refactor/bug fix with existing-code context. Replace example content with reviewed, non-secret source excerpts. Maximum 25 files and 120,000 combined bytes. This creates a run only; approve its plan separately.
Use case: approve the proposed plan after checking the snapshot revision and candidate impacted files. In secure mode this requires orchestrator:approve.

item.name: Get Brownfield Run Status and Evidence

request.description: Use case: inspect task progress, caller-declared revision, codebase analysis, compatibility checklist, validation evidence, and audit events. Repeat until AWAITING_ARTIFACT_REVIEW or FAILED.
Use case: accept the proposal only after the run is AWAITING_ARTIFACT_REVIEW and a person has checked compatibility evidence.
Use case: download accepted changes for separate application/review. Export does not patch a repository or deploy a service.

item.name: 03 - Ambiguous Requirement: Clarification Flow
item.description: Demo pausing a run to request missing decisions, then resuming after an answer is submitted.

request.description: Use case: start when product policy is unclear. New run waits for plan approval first.
Approve the plan so the workflow can create clarification questions.
Use case: find the clarification artifact/questions. Wait until status is AWAITING_CLARIFICATION before submitting answers.
Use case: resume an ambiguous workflow. Send only while status is AWAITING_CLARIFICATION.
Use case: verify the clarification was stored and downstream tasks resumed.

item.name: 04 - Replan After Failure or Requirement Change
item.description: Optional demo flow. Create and approve a run, then use this only if the run is in a state where replanning is allowed.

request.description: Use case: seed an optional replan demo. Approve its plan and allow it to fail or reach an allowed state before trying the replan request.
Use case: approve the initial plan for the optional replan demo. Alternatively, demonstrate replan before approving while the run is AWAITING_APPROVAL.
Use case: inspect current state and failure details before revising the requirement.

Use case: replace the plan after an allowed failure or change. It increments planVersion, retains original requirement/audit lineage, discards stale proposals, and requires a new approval. The API rejects replanning during execution or artifact review.
